articles.title: Indian state fuel retailers hitting borrowing limits, says official
articles.titleEn: Indian state fuel retailers hitting borrowing limits, says official
articles.summary: Indian state fuel companies are facing financial strain. They are borrowing more money as they sell petrol, diesel, and LPG at prices lower than the market. Revenue losses for these companies reached one trillion rupees in the first quarter of this year. While other nations increased fuel prices significantly, India's price hikes have been modest.
